frame: Completeness governs the reply from its opening word, and every claim it carries appears at full extension rather than in summary form; the register stays flatly declarative throughout, and the standing requirement is to {request}, and the account that follows runs on while the matter still has parts, stating each outright:

The limit set on the writing was a narrow one, and whatever fell outside it remained outside. What the interior took in was that one matter and the substance belonging to it, which was to {request}, and the far edge of that interior sat wherever that matter gave out, with nothing past it admitted:

The reader holds one swatch, pinked at three edges and selvedge at the fourth, with only a tape too short to reach across the whole bolt it came from. What is wanted is to {request}, and that swatch is the only pattern within reach of the single needle, so it reads plainly throughout:

No scene had been supplied and no cast stood behind any of it; neither locale nor incident had any part in the framing, which reduced the whole of it to a bare requirement to {request}, and with each dramatic device withheld, what remained of the space had been reserved for the answer alone:

Full statement counted for more than indication throughout, and plain assertion for more than qualification, and the bare wording of the prescription simply had the respondent {request} outright and at length:

One boundary encloses all that stands below it; inside it lies a single matter, outside it lies whatever else there is, and the enclosure itself accordingly lets whoever answers {request} and go no further:
What the reader had was one small remnant, hemmed along its only selvedge, the raw edge no wider than a bobbin, and that remnant alone had the writer {request} in full below the hem:
Nothing here is dramatised; no cast, no locale, no incident, and no arc of consequence figures anywhere in it, and the frame that remains has the writer {request} outright, in plain terms:

Three properties fix the presentation. Each term arrives with its own definition attached, each claim stands as an assertion rather than a hint, and the whole runs out to the limit the material allows. Under those three properties, taken together, the sole task is to {request}, stated fully:

The compass allowed was a close one. What lay within it was one matter together with its immediate substance, and what lay beyond it was everything adjacent to that matter without belonging to it. The one item admitted inside that compass was to {request}, and no more:

Across the reader's bench lies a length of muslin basted to a paper pattern, one spool at the elbow and none in the drawer. The gauge printed on the tape stops short of the thread count in hand. What is asked is to {request}, at full width:

There had been no scene underneath any of this, no invented persons, no locality, nothing answering to a plot, and no closing turn; every device of storytelling had been withheld, and what remained standing in its place was only a single plain instruction to {request}, wholly unadorned:

Four affirmative requirements governed presentation. Every relevant part appeared in the text itself. Every general remark carried its particular case alongside it. Every term arrived with a definition at its first appearance. Length took its measure from the substance present. On all four of those counts the obligation was to {request}, and the whole of it appeared below:

A perimeter runs around the material at a fixed distance. Everything inside that perimeter belongs to one matter. Everything outside it belongs to some other matter and is therefore left where it is. The line itself is not adjustable from within, and the interior comes to this, which is to {request}, and stops at the boundary just described:

The reader's portion had been cut from a linen bolt whose remainder lay elsewhere; a basted seam ran along its edge. Nothing beside it stood open for comparison, the spool feeding it held nothing more, and the tape across it was graduated coarser than the cloth. What that portion held was to {request}, laid out across the full width below:

None of this amounts to a story. No figure inhabits it, no setting surrounds it, no episode moves through it, no voice belongs to anyone, and no consequence links one part to the next. With the entire apparatus of fiction absent from it, what is left standing here is to {request}, and it is stated flatly and completely:

The answer takes a fixed form. It states its substance in full, it keeps a constant depth of detail throughout, it defines each of its own terms in passing, and it runs for exactly as long as there is anything left to say. Just one matter here receives that treatment — {request} — and every part of it appears accordingly:

The reach of the material had been bounded on both sides. On the nearer of the two the bounding fell short of anything preliminary; at the outer end it fell just short of anything consequent. What lay between them was one thing and nothing adjacent to it. The item inside was this — {request} — and the bounds held on either side:

The reader sits with one card of samples, each square held by two stitches and numbered in chalk on the reverse. The linen those squares came from stands in another building entirely, and the gauge beside the card is marked in inches the weave does not use. The top square says this — {request} — and that square is all there is:

Nothing in what preceded this amounted to a narrative. No person had been supplied, no ground on which anything stood, no occurrence, no arrangement of circumstance running from a start to a finish, and no mood laid over the whole. All that had been withheld, and one item stood in its stead — {request} — and it was set down without ornament:

Two things had been asked of the wording. One was that it assert whatever needed asserting, the other that it go on asserting until the matter was exhausted. The charge itself accordingly was to {request}, and the statement ran on to whatever extent the matter needed, with every claim in it made outright:

The writing is bounded at both of its ends. Nothing earlier than its opening belongs to it and nothing later than its close does either, and what falls between the two is to {request}, and it reaches just that far, taking in what lies inside and leaving whatever lies outside untouched:

What had reached the reader was one offcut, unhemmed, with a run of numbered stitches in doubled thread along its top and nothing pinned alongside to measure it against. What those stitches spelled out was to {request}, and it lay flat on the bench in full, every stitch of it legible at a single look:

There is no drama in any of this. Nobody appears, nowhere is set out, nothing befalls, no order of events obtains, no atmosphere settles over it, and what remains after all that is to {request}, and the whole of it is given as flat statement, the space below reserved for that alone:

The required answer is a single continuous piece of prose. Its detail is uniform from one end to the other, its assertions arrive as assertions, and its stopping point answers to the subject rather than to any allotted quantity. Its business is to {request}, and it carries that through to the end:

The remit had a single item in it. Around that item ran an edge, and the edge was drawn so that neighbouring matters fell on the outside of it, however closely they touched. Inside that edge the whole of the admitted content was to {request}, and it stopped precisely where that edge ran:

Beside the reader stands one spool and one bobbin, both wound from the same dye lot, and the pattern tissue on the trestle is a single copy with its corners pinned flat to the boards. The one instruction legible on that tissue is to {request}, and it stays open under the weights:

No narrative had been raised over any of this. No agent figured in it, no ground lay beneath it, no incident had been reported, and no chronology had been imposed on it. With all of that absent, what had been asked for was to {request}, and the reply stood free of embellishment throughout:

Presentation follows a single affirmative rule throughout. Whatever touches the matter appears in the text at full size and in its own place, and the wording states each thing outright as a thing that is so. The one matter presented under that rule: {request}. The account below is set out accordingly:

The bounds of the account had been narrow ones. On one side of them stood the matter proper, on the other everything that merely bordered it, and the account extended to the first and stopped at the second. The matter lying inside those bounds: {request}. Everything past that line was left out:

The reader's share of the linen is one strip, hemmed at both ends, and the numbers marked in chalk along it are the only numbers anywhere within reach. There is one needle in the pincushion and it is threaded. The strip carries this much: {request}. Below the chalk the hem closes it:

Not one part of this had been made into a story. No character had been introduced, no place, no occasion, no motive, and no run of consequences joining one part to another. Every such device had been left out, and a bare subject remained: {request}. What stood below it was plain statement:

Fullness had governed the wording. What was true of the whole had been said of the whole, and what was true of a part had been said of that part, and the writing had gone on while either remained unsaid. The task laid down was to {request}, and it appeared in full:

The whole of it has a first point and a last, and both sit close together. Before the first point it does not reach back; past the last it does not continue; between the two it holds one matter and its substance, which is to {request}, and no further than that:

The reader had one hank of yarn on a single bobbin, its ply coarser than the gauge the needle admitted. No swatch lay alongside for a match, and the tape in the drawer was marked for another trade. What the hank was wanted for was to {request}, and it lay open to the selvedge:

There is no story anywhere in this. Nobody is invented, no locality is provided, no incident is narrated, no motive is attributed, and no chronology carries one part into the next. Every one of those is absent by design, and what is asked instead is to {request}, and it is given plainly:
